The official Transolver-family repositories are vendored unchanged for local
research reproducibility. Commits, source-file SHA256 checksums, constructor
settings and reference gaps are recorded in transformer_sources.json.

Transolver: thuml/Transolver; upstream MIT license is retained in Transolver/LICENSE.
Transolver++: thuml/Transolver_plus; upstream MIT license is retained in Transolver_plus/LICENSE.
Transolver-3: thuml/Transolver-3; the pinned upstream commit does not contain a
LICENSE file. No MIT or other license is inferred or added for that repository.

The geobc adapter leaves source architecture and attention behavior intact.
Its only dependency binding maps timm's truncated-normal initializer to the
equivalent torch.nn.init.trunc_normal_. Official einops is installed separately.
Activation checkpointing preserves RNG state. TS3 chunks share global states;
Transolver++ retains its upstream stochastic Gumbel behavior in evaluation.
